name: month_successor
description: Name the month that comes k months after a given month (calendar month arithmetic). Control: integer successor with the same sentence frame.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
M=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
items=[];control=[]
templates=["Q: What month comes {k} after {m}?\nA: The answer is","If it is {m} now, then {k} from now it will be"]
for i in range(120):
    j=random.randrange(12); k=random.choice([1,1,2,3]); t=random.choice(templates)
    ks={1:'one month',2:'two months',3:'three months'}[k]
    items.append({"prompt":t.format(k=ks,m=M[j]),"answer":" "+M[(j+k)%12]})
for i in range(120):
    n=random.randrange(3,90); k=random.choice([1,1,2,3]); t=random.choice(["Q: What number comes {k} after {m}?\nA: The answer is","If the counter shows {m} now, then {k} later it will show"])
    ks={1:'one step',2:'two steps',3:'three steps'}[k]
    control.append({"prompt":t.format(k=ks,m=n),"answer":" "+str(n+k)})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
